$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
for p in terminal/AGENTS.md terminal/README.md terminal/tasks/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/README.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/README.md;do if test -f "$p";then printf 'ADDITIONAL_DOC %s\n' "$p";cat "$p";exit 2;fi;done
DST='terminal/tasks/fishFry/rim_arc_radial_measurements_20261109'
test ! -e "$DST"
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/comments/6737743561 --jq .body > /tmp/fishfry_previous_command.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
body=json.loads(Path('/tmp/fishfry_previous_command.json').read_text())
command=body['whatPrompt']
prefix="cat > \"$DST/measure_rim.py\" <<'PY'\n"
assert prefix in command
script=command.split(prefix,1)[1].split('\nPY\n',1)[0]
assert script.startswith('#!/usr/bin/env python3')
assert script.count('N=9')==1
assert script.count('assert len(out)==9')==1
assert script.count('Nine measured outer-rim points and eight equal fitted-circle arc intervals')==1
script=script.replace('N=9','N=5').replace('assert len(out)==9','assert len(out)==5')
script=script.replace('Nine measured outer-rim points and eight equal fitted-circle arc intervals','Five measured outer-rim points and four equal fitted-circle arc intervals')
Path('/tmp/fishfry_measure_rim_five.py').write_text(script+'\n')
print('VERIFIED_SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTION','Issue3 comment 6737743561','five points across same fitted rim extent')
PY
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_rim_measurements_five_venv
/tmp/fishfry_rim_measurements_five_venv/bin/python -m pip -q install opencv-python-headless scipy
/tmp/fishfry_rim_measurements_five_venv/bin/python /tmp/fishfry_measure_rim_five.py
cp /tmp/fishfry_measure_rim_five.py "$DST/measure_rim.py"
test "$(find "$DST" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 6
git add -- "$DST"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 6
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Measure five outer rim radii with four equal arc-length intervals'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
 printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
 git fetch --quiet origin main
 git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
 if git push origin HEAD:main;then
   printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
   printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
   for f in "$DST"/*;do
      A=$(git hash-object "$f")
      B=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha)
      test "$A" = "$B"
      printf 'VERIFIED_REMOTE %s %s\n' "$f" "$B"
   done
   exit 0
 fi
done
echo PUBLICATION_FAILED >&2
exit 1
